About the College
Dr B.K.B. College established in 1967 has gradually emerged to be a premier institution of higher education with a difference. The college is named after Dr. Birinchi Kumar Barooah - a dedicated teacher, folklorist, research scholar and a renowned litteratuer of Assam who was born in the famous Kharangi Barooah family of Puranigudam. The college offers two years Higher Secondary Course under Assam Higher Secondary Education Council and Three Years Degree Course under Gauhati University in Arts. About one thousand students get their regular education upto degree standard with major in seven subjects. Three new general subjects viz. Sociology, Psychology and Sattriya Dance have been introduced recently. Apart from the regular course of study, a number of students get enrolled in Institute of Distance and Open Learning (IDOL) under Gauhati University, Krishna Kanta Handique State Open University and Diploma in Elementary Education Course (D. El. Ed.) erery year. A one year career Oriented Course (Fashion, Textile and Interior Designing) also continuing in the college under Gauhati University. With the celebration of its Silver Jubilee year in 1993 the institution humbly announces its steady progress, serious commitment to quality education. ..
Read More
Dr. Birinchi Kumar Barooah College, in short Dr. B.K.B. College, a premier rural college has its own existence and identity in the field of higher education in Assam. The college was named after the famous scholar folklorist and doyen of Assamese literature Dr. Birinchi Kumar Barooah(1908-1964) who hails from Puranigudam, the location of the college. Historically and culturally wealthy Puranigudam situated beside the NH 37 in Nagaon District of Assam was also the birth place of Manik Chandra Baruah, Bholanath Baruah, Devakanta Baruah, Nabakanta Baruah and Rudra Baruah who played seminal role in their respective filed of art and literature, business and politics in making a modern Assam.
Dr. B.K.B. College, one of the oldest colleges in Nagaon District, has been doing yeoman service since its establishment in 1967 catering to the needs of higher education of the rural and marginalised section of the society of greater Puranigudam. The college has been striving for excellence in its capacity and role already set in its vision and mission. After two cycles of NAAC assessment and accreditation successfully completed we are preparing for the third cycle of NAAC assessment in new vigour and zeal.
The college with about thirteen hundred regular students and an excellent faculty at present offers two year Higher Secondary Course in Arts and Commerce under Assam Higher Secondary Education Council and Undergraduate Courses in Arts and Commerce, and B.Voc under Gauhati University. Besides the regular courses a sumptuous number of students have been pursuing different courses offered by the Centres of the Institute of Distance & Open Learning (IDOL) of Gauhati University and Krishna Kanta Handique State Open University (KKHSOU) functioning at our college.
After the celebration of Golden Jubilee Year during 2016-2017 the college is now morally boosted up and introspection of 50 years already passed made the vision clear to our eyes. We are always committed to fructify our goals and to face the challenges in front of us. We know that we have to stride ahead in a new pace in the changing scenario of higher education in the country, because we have miles to go before we reach the pinnacle of success.
From The Principal's Desk
Dr. Nripen Chandra Das
MA, LLB, Ph.D.
